dialogue_texts: Ah... ahahaha! Splendid! Truly, the power of your boundaries is nothing short of breathtaking.
Flattery will not mend the tears you've made in the fabric of this cemetery, my dear.
You are completely wide open now.
Shall we discuss the true architecture of this parallel experiment, or must I lock you away?
Let us see if your light can pierce the eternal shroud!
Oh, don't tell me you're attempting a conversational temporal loop.
Resetting the script won't change the fact that your danmaku has already been shattered.
Try to answer me properly this time.
Heh... You think you've won just because you cleared my danmaku?
The Order's roots run deeper than this cemetery, My Majesty.
Let it crumble. Realities can be restitched, and empires can be rebuilt.
But as for you and the rest of the Order...
I believe it's time you were completely isolated from the society you desperately wish to rule.
Enjoy the silence of your own broken parallel.
